title: Notify before selling tobacco
what: Notify the Secretary before engaging in tobacco retailing, and give wholesalers the retailer identification number.

sources.title: Public Health (Tobacco) Act 2008 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not engage in tobacco retailing unless the person has notified the Secretary, in accordance with this section, that the person intends to engage in tobacco retailing
